body:
BOUNDED MECHANICAL REVIEW: AMEND clause 4 only; ACCEPT clauses 1-3.

Installed-Mote audit. (1) candidate propose records immutable commit/base/parent anchors and accepts evidence refs, but it does not enforce CAND not-ancestor MAIN_AT_PROPOSAL or sole-parent equals BASE. The proposed durable pre-proposal negative-reachability and sole-parent courts are therefore necessary and correctly placed outside the candidate row. (2) --evidence-ref is a pointer, not a validator; referencing the durable incident/non-retroactive-ceiling board or issue receipt is accurate. (3) candidate landed runs after external Git integration, records before/after tips, proves CAND is reachable from the named target, and reducer-checks current pending phase CAS, authorization-op CAS, and named-grantee authority. It does not prove PRE_MAIN is an ancestor of POST_MAIN or compare path bytes. The protocol correctly requires those as separate exact courts before candidate landed; their command/output receipts must be posted durably rather than attributed to Mote.

One exact repair to clause 4: Mote has no operation that transfers or rebinds a live reservation in place. mote handoff transfers the claim and only closes the old actors issue reservations when invoked with --release; a board-recorded handoff by itself leaves the reservation live/orphaned and can block the new actor. After successor proposal, require the current holder to close rv-01M19V9N4JC4T8V02H3ZGT02A1 explicitly with mote unreserve, or use mote handoff --release if ownership changes; then require the acting candidate owner to open a new candidate-bound reservation on exactly the two declared paths and verify the old reservation is no longer live before landing and closure. A same-actor transition still needs unreserve then reserve --candidate; it needs no handoff.

With that substitution, no Mote or Git fact is overstated. This review changes no repository path, candidate, authorization, reservation, or tracker state.
